_comment: One fully worked planner beat. scripts/gemini-visual-plan.js embeds this file in the planner prompt (the model cannot open files). Since 2026-10-03 the planner DESCRIBES the scene only — no visual_type, data, composition or zone: scripts/scene-translate.js turns scene_description into the composition and the gates check it.
sentence: Jerome Powell said rates will stay high.

beat.headline: Rates stay high
beat.scene_description: A portrait of Jerome Powell, the Federal Reserve chairman, standing in the lower half of the frame; a slow push in across the beat. Above him, small caps: RATES WILL. The headline pops in word by word.
